Questions before we build

Website upgrades receive a tailored quote for an agreed scope. Pages, content, integrations and migration determine the final quote. Hosting, domains, external subscriptions and any VAT are listed separately in the proposal.

A website introduces your business and its services across several pages. A landing page focuses on one audience, offer and next step. I choose the scope around how visitors arrive and what they need before making an enquiry.

I start with your audience, offer and goal. Then we agree the structure and quote, design the pages, build the agreed features, review the work together and prepare the launch and handover. The delivery schedule is agreed in your proposal.

Responsive development is included in the website service. The agreed pages, navigation and forms are checked at different screen sizes before handover. Project-specific integrations and supported browsers are agreed in the scope.
